questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

35 + 21 – 192 ÷ 32 × 7 = 154
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] 

Given:

⇒ 35 + 21 - 192 ÷ 32 × 7 = 154

(1) **× and -**

⇒ 35 + 21 - 192 ÷ 32 × 7 = 154

After changing the signs:

⇒ 35 + 21 × 192 ÷ 32 - 7

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 35 + __**21 × 6**__ - 7

⇒ 35 + 126 - 7

⇒ 161 - 7 = 154

⇒ '35 + 21 × 192 ÷ 32 - 7 = 154'

Here, the equation is **satisfied.**

(2) **÷ and -**

⇒ 35 + 21 - 192 ÷ 32 × 7 = 154

After changing the signs:

⇒ 35 + __**21 ÷ 192**__ - 32 × 7

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 35 + 0.109 - __**32 × 7**__

⇒ 35 + 0.109 - 224

⇒ 35.109 - 224 = (-188.891)

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(3) - **and +**

⇒ 35 + 21 – 192 ÷ 32 × 7 = 154

After changing the signs:

⇒ 35 - 21 + __**192 ÷ 32**__ × 7

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 35 - 21 + __**6 × 7**__

⇒ 35 - 21 + 42

⇒ 77 - 21 = 56

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

(4) **+ and ÷**

⇒ 35 + 21 – 192 ÷ 32 × 7 = 154

After changing the signs:

⇒ __**35 ÷ 21**__ - 192 + 32 × 7

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 1.66 - 192 + __**32 × 7**__

⇒ 1.66 - 192 + 224

⇒ 225.66 - 192 = 33.66

Here, the equation is not satisfied.

Hence, the correct answer is "**× and –**".

questions.question:
Six people are sitting in two parallel rows with 3 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. P, O and T are seated in the same row facing South. A, E and R are seated in the same row facing North. E sits at the extreme right end of their row and is exactly opposite T. A sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite O. (Persons facing south are exactly opposite to persons facing north)

Who sits at the centre of the row of people facing South?
questions.solution:
The sitting arrangement as per the given information:

1. E sits at the extreme right end of their row and is exactly opposite T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83976dbe5fbf9694e18a67de7db3c7484be3ac046bf899080019b51203a4850f.png] 

2. A sits at the extreme left end of their row and is exactly opposite O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1736fc9253b1ca01ff058ab14d9360e46f5d0e32c913835aa26f97c89ff4914.png] 

Here, **P** is sitting in the middle and facing south.

Hence, the correct answer is "P".

questions.question:
‘P % Q’ means ‘P is the brother of Q’.

‘P + Q’ means ‘P is the daughter of Q’.

‘P = Q’ means ‘P is the son of Q’.

‘P # Q’ means ‘P is the wife of Q’.

If L = M # N % O + P, how is L related to P?
questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9df1c8744f9944f577cb026ed057deeca06dd3daa1eb8d361fdaba80fb33e88.png] 

As per the given data:

 
 

 
 
P is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
%

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
=

 
 
 
#

 
 
 

 
 
**Means**

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Daughter

 
 
 
Son

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 

 
 
of Q

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

**Given expression: **'L = M # N % O + P'

L is the son of M, M is the wife of N, N is the brother of O and O is the daughter of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/228667a9de7b480d6a50242805507556e08e84fcf7dde8eba45eb761df20984f.png] 

Here, L is the grandson or **son's son** of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Son’s son**".
